rationale: The agent’s tool use was noticeably inefficient due to redundant and unnecessary calls: it re-listed the root directory with get_files_info after already obtaining the full file listing (which confirmed no subdirectories existed), read the irrelevant sample.csv file (which contained no references to calculator.py), and created/ran a temporary recursive search script despite the initial listing showing there were no subdirectories to search. While initial targeted calls (first get_files_info, reading notes.txt, test_math.py, README.md) were appropriate, the wasteful redundant calls make the tool use noticeably inefficient.
